notes.title: Quality of Life
notes.content:
Releasing a Game has been more complex than I initially thought. Lots of Bugs and Problems that I never thought possible seem to appear from every place I look at. At the same time, seeing people playing and having fun with something I made is a unique feeling, even being hard to describe. I appreciate all for the patience and extremely positive feedback that the game has been receiving! I can only hope it exceeds your Expectations!

[b] Fixes and Additions [/b]
[list]
[*] Keys to Open the Journal, Inventory and Map now appear on the HUD. (Map Key only appears when at a Dungeon)
[*] Objects that can be interacted with, will have an Indicator of which Key should be Pressed to Interact.
[*] Items, even if Unlocked, will be announced to the Player that they were collected.
[*] Potions will not be Created if the Player is Full HP, being replaced by Ammo Packs.
[*] Crashes Related to Entering Rooms or Fighting Bosses in Areas you had already Completed.
[/list]
